notes.title: Update Notice (May 2, 2025)
notes.content:
Update Notice (May 2, 2025)
Current Time: Friday, May 2, 2025 (Lunar Date: 6th Day of the Fourth Month, Year of the Wood Snake), 23:59

Update Highlights
Performance Optimization
Improved LUMEN Global Illumination performance, reducing frame rate drops and increasing average FPS by 20-30 frames.
Difficulty Customization
Added Difficulty Selection in settings, allowing players to adjust challenge levels within a -10 to 10 range (lower values for casual play, higher for hardcore modes).
New Boss Challenge
Unlocked the Trials Realm after defeating A Vision of Deity (画中仙). Accessible via teleportation in the central tower for advanced combat trials.
Visual Adjustments
Reduced excessive fog effects in specific scenes to improve visibility and exploration clarity.

1.      Optimize the photo mode
2.      Fixed the issue where "Close Bag/Menu" did not take effect after the default value of "Button-Bag/Menu" was modified

notes.title: Update Notice (April 21, 2025) Current Time: Monday, April 21, 2025
notes.content:
Update Highlights
1.	UI Optimization
•	Added G-key Potion Count Display to improve inventory management clarity.
2.	Bug Fixes
•	Fixed an issue where the Tomb Guardian could push players outside the map boundaries.
•	Resolved dialogue freeze during interactions with Mountain Sage.
3.	Boss Adjustments
•	Red Lotus Inferno Buddha (Difficulty Rebalance):
•	Removed the disappearing teleportation skill to reduce frustration.
•	Increased Block Gauge rewards and enhanced execution damage for combat fluidity.
•	Wuchang Terrain Adjustments:
•	Smoothed terrain layout and reduced probability of phase 2 clone spawns.
4.	Level Design Improvements
•	Optimized pathing at the collapsed city wall scaffolding in Chapter 1.
•	Adjusted collision detection for volumetric clouds to mitigate frame rate drops.
5.	Achievement System Tweaks
•	Revamped achievement logic for:
•	Mountain Sage's Slayer (kill conditions).
•	Xiao Hong's Redemption (rescue/kill outcomes).
________________________________________
Key Takeaways
•	Combat & Balance: Focus on streamlining high-difficulty encounters (e.g., Red Lotus Buddha) while rewarding defensive playstyles.
•	Exploration & Progression: Smoother level navigation and reduced RNG elements (e.g., Wuchang clones).
•	Technical Polish: Targeted fixes for performance bottlenecks and progression blockers.
________________________________________
Thank you for your continued support and feedback!
Follow our official channels for real-time updates.
________________________________________
Translation Notes
1.	Consistency:
•	Retained original boss names (e.g., "Wuchang," "Mountain Sage") to align with in-game lore.
•	"Execution damage" contextualized for action-RPG mechanics.
2.	Technical Localization:
•	Terms like "volumetric clouds" and "frame rate drops" standardize technical descriptions.
3.	Player-Centric Tone:
•	Structured updates to highlight gameplay impact (e.g., "reduced frustration," "mitigate RNG").
4.	Formatting:
•	Merged related entries (e.g., achievements) for readability while adhering to the 5-point limit per section.

notes.title: 《Yiwenlu: Reincarnation》Update Notice Release Date: April 19, 2025
notes.content:
1.	UI Adjustment
•	Disabled the hidden UI toggle feature to prevent accidental activation.
2.	Bug Fixes
•	Fixed the "Bi Bing Gu" resurrection bug that caused double revives.
•	Corrected abnormal behavior of Lightning/Poison/Fire Resistance Orbs.
•	Resolved ineffectiveness of the Anti-Numbness Powder item.
•	Optimized performance for resurrection-related input lag.
•	Addressed issues where some enemies (e.g., Thunder Aphid) could burrow underground unexpectedly.
•	Fixed execution animations not triggering death sequences properly for specific enemies.
3.	Optimizations
•	Improved level design and navigation in the "Other Shore" stage2.
•	Adjusted execution sound effects for the Tomb Guardian boss.
•	Fixed facing direction during execution animations for the Thousand-Eye Blue Light enemy.
•	Optimized collision detection to prevent character-stuck scenarios.
4.	Additional Notes
This update follows the game's launch roadmap2, continuing to refine combat mechanics and player experience. Further content expansions, including new chapters and DLCs, will be announced soon.
Thank you for your continued support and feedback!
________________________________________
Key Localization Considerations
•	Retained pinyin for culturally specific terms (e.g., Bi Bing Gu) to preserve authenticity, aligning with game localization best practices212.
•	Technical terms like "Anti-Numbness Powder" (Quma Fen) were adapted for clarity while maintaining gameplay context.
•	Structured formatting matches industry-standard patch notes for readability16.

notes.title: Announcement: "Echoes of Yi Samsara: Samsara" Now Available
notes.content:
Announcement: "Chronicles of Chivalry: Samsara" Now Available
Title: The Journey is Long, Thanks for Having You

Greetings, Heroes of the Martial World!

We are the development team behind Echoes of Yi Samsara—a small indie studio of just eight members. After months of anticipation, our game is finally ready to meet you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839201/018b6b892c3443b83b53641ba7ceb87660d02676.png[/img]
Price: 78 RMB (66 RMB during the first week with launch discount).Global Release: April 18, 2025.

We fully acknowledge that compared to AAA titles like Black Myth: Wukong or Phantom Blade, we’re still mere minnows in the vast ocean of game development, constantly learning and growing. But our passion for action games burns fiercely. We’ve poured our hearts into creating a wuxia-inspired world filled with Chinese-style combat and storytelling.

Echoes of Yi Samsara is not just a game—it’s a labor of love and a tribute to every player who has supported us. Without your encouragement, we would never have reached this milestone.

We believe sincerity bridges hearts. Through this project, we hope to share our dedication and the countless hours we’ve devoted to crafting this experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839201/a1a1bb73855b21e3b71fe136e1415acbdb35e84f.png[/img]
The journey is long, but with you by our side, every step feels meaningful.

P.S. As a small team, we know the game may have imperfections. We warmly welcome your feedback and will strive to improve, ensuring a better experience for all!

With gratitude,
The Echoes of Yi Samsara: Samsara Team

notes.title: "Samsara" Production Team's New Year Gift
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839201/c420116344e9f9db422db2a4a504f1a62f97f2c0.png[/img]
On the occasion of the Spring Festival, the production team of "Samsara" offers our sincere wishes and blessings to all the players who love and support us! On this joyful day, we not only want to thank everyone for your companionship and encouragement over the past year, but also excitedly announce an inspiring news - the brand new character, the dancer WanQing, is about to make a stunning appearance, and more exciting content is in preparation. Stay tuned!

Looking back on the past year, from the initial release of the DEMO to now, it has been exactly 365 days. "Samsara" has undergone countless iterations and sublimations during this journey. Whether it's the meticulous art design, the intense combat system, the smooth execution moves, or the rich expansion of the storyline, they all embody the hard work and wisdom of our team. Now, we are busy with the final audio optimization and dubbing work, striving for perfection in every detail. We believe that a more splendid and colorful world of "Samsara" will soon meet everyone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839201/32affcbb9949dbc38fed9b99b30b97ee04f841de.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839201/6f70bfe7de5bb79544d99f5785966909f62e37e0.gif[/img]

In this upcoming feast, the dancer WanQing is undoubtedly the brightest scenery. To shape this character, we deeply explored the essence of Chinese style and cleverly integrated opera elements into it. The addition of martial actor and clown roles not only enriches the game's character system but also adds a strong cultural heritage to WanQing's story. We know that the vitality of a character lies in its uniqueness and storytelling, so with the help of friends, we successfully obtained the music license for the classic song "Chiling".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839201/45d12155804296f5078d3dabbdb885d55505bcc9.gif[/img]

The melody of "Chiling" is sorrowful and moving. To perfectly present the fusion of music and character, we were fortunate to invite performers from the Shanghai Theater Academy. They not only designed a water sleeve dance for WanQing but also participated in motion capture work, portraying every dance move and every look vividly. The water sleeves fluttered lightly like floating clouds and flowing water, and WanQing danced gracefully on the stage, seemingly traversing time and space to narrate the dust-laden story. This innovative attempt not only makes the character of WanQing more vivid but also adds a rich touch to the game's storyline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839201/abb21f318c4eb1ceee04cf01e8e819cee2deff23.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839201/4b36af1c7c0db61c879c42a30eb0012a141e095a.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839201/031ccfe35c1d77fe04ea4f466543ee3a3691d0ed.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839201/15c3491c97cf07d709f57fa5c82698ceff34e5d5.gif[/img]

During the creative process, we witnessed Wanqing's transformation from the initial concept setting to the present vivid form, with every detail reflecting the team's pursuit and love for art. From the exquisite clothing design, repeated deliberation on dance moves, to the emotional interpretation of voice actors, every step strives for perfection. We believe that when players witness Wanqing shining on stage, they will be deeply attracted by her charm.

Looking ahead, "Samsara" will continue to uphold the spirit of craftsmanship, constantly explore and innovate, bringing more exciting content to players. We know that it is the support and suggestions of players that drive us forward, so we want to express our sincerest gratitude to every player here. May everyone be healthy, happy, and write our legendary chapter with "Samsara" in the new year.

The dancer WanQing, with a song called "Chiling", is waiting to meet you. In the world of "Samsara", there are more unknown stories waiting for you to explore, and more exciting characters waiting for you to meet. Let's work together and look forward to this future full of infinite possibilities!

notes.title: Fix for "Unreal Engine exits due to D3D device loss" Crash
notes.content:
Some users have resolved this issue by installing older versions of the NVIDIA Game Ready driver. Other users can follow these steps:

Click the link to open the official NVIDIA page:
https://nvidia.custhelp.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/5157/~/after-updating-to-nvidia-game-ready-driver-461.09-or-newer%2C-some-desktop-apps

As of September 24, 2021, NVIDIA has released a fix, stating that NVIDIA Game Ready drivers version 461.09 and higher may cause this issue.

Download mpo_disable.reg:
Click the link above to go to the corresponding page, and the first file is mpo_disable.reg—download it.

Open mpo_disable.reg:
Open the downloaded file. Follow the prompts you receive, click "Yes." This will add a key to disable multiplane overlay in your system registry (you may not notice any changes).

Restart your computer:
Registry changes load with the operating system, so you need to restart your computer to apply the changes.
